no_adcom_quote.quote: This Application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for BLA761083 (Hemlibra/emicizumab). The FDA review states the application was not presented to an advisory committee; the OtherR filing checklist records the reason as 'The application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues,' and the administrative correspondence records 'No AC meeting.' Instead, the Division held a single teleconference with a special government employee (a hemophilia patient representative) on October 31, 2017, to discuss the benefit:risk profile in light of the TMA/TE safety signal, but this was not an advisory committee, so there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
